# Primed Grocery List - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A Flutter shopping list app with two modes: edit mode (manage items) and shopping mode (check off purchased items). The app uses Riverpod for state management and Hive for local storage. The UI is designed to be simple and user-friendly, with a focus on functionality and ease of use.

## User Instructions
- Feel free to refactor parts of the application to improve readability, maintainability, and performance.

- Focus on best practices for Flutter development, such as using state management solutions (e.g., Provider, Riverpod) and optimizing widget rebuilds.

- Ensure feature requests are tested and well categorized (eg UI, state management).
